download_audio.description: Download the audio file of one recording so a later step can attach it to an email, drop it in storage or play it back. Find a recording id with Search audio recordings, or ask Get sentence to include audio. Recordings whose reader did not allow reuse outside Tatoeba cannot be downloaded and return a clear error saying so.
download_audio.name: download_audio

parameters.description: The recording's Tatoeba id (for example 891), or its download URL.
parameters.name: audio_id

get_member.description: Read a Tatoeba member's public profile: the role they hold, the date they joined, and every language they have declared with their self-assessed level in it.
get_member.name: get_member

parameters.description: The member's Tatoeba username, or the URL of their profile page.
parameters.name: username

get_random_sentence.description: Pick one sentence at random out of everything matching your filters: a sentence of the day, a flashcard prompt, or a listening drill when you ask for one that has audio.

translate_text.description: Find how real people say a word or phrase in other languages, by looking it up in Tatoeba's corpus and returning the human-written translations of the sentences that contain it. Unlike a machine translator this always answers with sentences somebody actually wrote, each with a link to its page.

description: Look up example sentences and their human-written translations in Tatoeba, the free collaborative corpus covering more than 400 languages. Search or filter sentences, translate a phrase, pull a random sentence for practice, follow a contributor, and find or download the audio recordings members have made. Free and open, with no account or API key required.
